newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - Dow Chemical shares slip.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - Dow Chemical shares slip.

text.p: Shares of Dow Chemical Co slipped in post-close trading Monday after a state jury in a class action lawsuit determined the company was negligent in testing silicone for human breast implants.
Traders said Dow shares were trading at 89-1/8, off from its close of 90.

A Louisiana jury ruled against the Midland, Michigan-based company in a suit alleging the implants were dangerous and that the company knew it. The case now moves to phase two to determine if women were injured as a result.

Traders said shares of most other stocks were moving in-line with their closing prices after a day in which U.S. blue chips took a near-record plunge before bargain hunters stepped in for a dramatic turnaround.
The Dow Jones Industrial Average closed up nearly 109 points at 7,803.
The New York Stock Exchange said session one had volume of 61,000, compared with 99,300 Friday and said there was no activity in session two, compared to 7.4 million Friday.
